summary: Tested new P1 IMEI Repair modal in demo mode. All 12 spec items PASSED: modal opens only via Repair IMEI button (never immediately), correct structure (title, imei1/imei2 inputs, legal checkbox, cancel/submit buttons), input sanitization (strips non-digits, caps at 15), Luhn validation (invalid=123456789012345 shows 'Invalid' + submit disabled; valid=490154203237518 shows 'Luhn OK'), submit gating requires both valid IMEI1 AND legal checkbox, IMEI2='123' correctly disables submit, empty IMEI2 allowed, submit streams demo log with '>>> EXECUTING (DEMO): Repair IMEI' and 'Writing IMEI1: 490154203237518' (entered value, not random), modal closes on submit, fields reset on reopen, Cancel closes+resets. Regression: Bypass FRP still fires directly (no modal), all 9 nav routes load, setup wizard trigger present, 0 console errors. One observation on auto-connect timing (see below).

observations.issue: Test spec expects device to auto-connect 'within a few seconds' of landing on dashboard. Waited 6.5s post-login and Repair IMEI button was still disabled (status=idle, no boot logs streaming yet). Had to click START SCAN manually to get a connected device. Once connected, all downstream modal tests passed. Likely cause: AuthContext verification (/api/auth/me) takes several seconds before AppShell mounts and boot sequence starts, so real elapsed wall-clock from login to auto-connect exceeds a 'few seconds'. Not blocking IMEI feature — flagging for main agent.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate why device does not auto-connect within ~6s after login redirect to dashboard (AppShell/AppProvider likely mounts after AuthContext resolves). Consider a loading hint or verify autoConnect useEffect fires promptly.
critical_code_review_comments: IMEIRepairModal.jsx (168 lines): Clean, single-responsibility Radix Dialog. Luhn implementation correct. Submit gating (imei1Valid && imei2Valid && agreed && status==='connected') is defensive.
AppContext.runAction: params.imei1/imei2 override device.imei/imei2 only when params.imei1 truthy — good, keeps other actions unaffected.
ActionGrid.handleAction: repair_imei correctly short-circuits to setImeiModalOpen(true) instead of runAction.
Minor: IMEIRepairModal reset happens on close via handleClose but also on explicit Cancel path — no double-reset issues observed.
seed_data_creation: None. Test used seeded admin only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMEI Repair modal (P1) fully verified in demo mode. Valid Luhn IMEI for tests: 490154203237518. Invalid: 123456789012345. To reach the connected state during tests, either wait 8-10s after login OR click the 'START SCAN (DEMO)' button on the Device Status panel — dashboard auto-connect boot chain (1.9s + 2.8s handshake) fires only after AuthContext finishes verifying, which can push total time past a naive wait. The Repair IMEI button on Dashboard uses platform=ALL so it enables for any chipset.
